Perfect! White has won the rook cleanly with Qc6+. The queen on a8 is active and Black is down a full rook.

**Best move:** Qc6+

**Main line:** 1.Qc6+ Qd7 2.Qxa8+ Ke7 3.Qa7 (or White is simply up a rook)

**Motif:** fork (the queen forks the king on e8 and the rook on a8, both undefended)

**Coaching explanation:**

Your queen on b7 can give check while simultaneously attacking the undefended rook on a8—a royal fork! After Qc6+, Black must move the king (Ke7) or block with the queen (Qd7), but either way you capture the rook with Qxa8+, winning decisive material. Look for checks that attack multiple pieces at once.
